name: Bollinger(50, 1.5) 0.618 band buy with EMA50>EMA200 filter
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: Bollinger basis/dev with 0.618 multiplier, EMA50, EMA200
entry_long: basis = MA of hlc3 (length 50), dev = 1.5 x stdev; lower_618 = basis - 0.618 x dev. With EMA50 > EMA200, buy when close < lower_618 or low <= lower_618.
exit: Close when close crosses above upper_618 = basis + 0.618 x dev; or stop when close < stopLossVal (Stop Loss input 5, % below entry).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
implementation_notes: Source says it gives similar results across different timeframes (author claim, unverified).
